paragraph: Tripathy identifies her own story “ବିଦେହ (Bideha)” as the source of the film. She recalls writing it in 2005 or 2006 and says it appears in her collection *କଡ଼ାପାନ ଓ କ୍ଲିଓପାଟ୍ରା (Kadapana o Cleopatra)*. An Odisha government catalogue lists the collection’s first edition, published by Pakshighara Prakashanee in 2010.[^bideha-story]
note: [^bideha-story]: Surya Kanta Jena, [“ସାହିତ୍ୟ ଓ ସିନେମାର ଯୁଗଳବନ୍ଦୀ”](https://sambad.in/special/the-pairing-of-literature-and-cinema-11010926), *Sambad*, 19 January 2026, interview; Odisha Culture Department, [selected books, 2010–11](https://culture.odisha.gov.in/sites/default/files/2022-06/List%20of%20Selected%20Books%20Under%20Raja%20Rammohan%20Ray%20Library%20Foundation%20%28RRRLF%29%20Scheme%20for%20the%20Year%202010-11.pdf#page=11), p. 11, entry 262.
limits: Source identity and composition dates explicitly attributed to author recollection.
2010 describes catalogue first edition of collection, not first story publication.
